planning_notes: The request for 5 EASY targets was fulfilled by selecting the 5 most distinct core concepts and mechanisms from the available pool. To ensure non-redundancy, each target focuses on a unique functional area: (1) Database Context Switching, (2) Collection Lifecycle Management, (3) Document Insertion, (4) CRUD Operations (general), and (5) Collection Management (general). The assessment facets were chosen to align with the EASY difficulty level, prioritizing CONCEPT_UNDERSTANDING and CODE_INTERPRETATION to verify fundamental syntax and definition recall without requiring complex analysis or edge-case debugging.
